ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (near-black) background with high-intensity (near-white) localized pixel clusters forming a high-contrast ratio across approximately 15% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular rings (annular blobs) are distributed stochastically across the entire visible surface. A series of parallel, high-intensity linear segments is mapped to the upper-outer quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep vertical bounding-box depth relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and deep valleys. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits lower-amplitude, high-frequency serrations with visible parallel vertical scarring patterns.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lateral outer boundaries follow a convex curve, while the trailing edges follow a complex concave trajectory toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular and elliptical white rings (barnacle attachment scars) are detected across the central and lower regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of 6-8 parallel vertical linear streaks on the right lobe trailing edge; single horizontal linear disruption on the left lobe adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue voids (notches) on the trailing edge of the left lobe; pervasive circular scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Comb-like parallel scarring pattern on the trailing edge of the right lobe creating a unique serrated visual signature.
